title: odontarrhena oxycarpa
intro: Odontarrhena oxycarpa, commonly known as Oxycarpus, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate conditions such as fever and rheumatism. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
